clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, ghouls roam the groves and cemeteries, and Abercrombie asks for their ribs. The hermit says he needs them to build an effigy that will ward off the flesh-eating horrors near his shack.

Ghouls haunt Duskwood, among them Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders. Abercrombie lives alone in a shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery and asks travelers for their sturdy, rotted ribs. He says he lives beyond the Night Watch’s protection in Darkshire and needs a fearsome effigy to frighten the dead away from his home.
